On the left side there is first a vertical side, labeled 12 inches, then connected to a side slanting upward to the right, labeled 8 inches. The right side is a vertical side, labeled 18 inches. At the top, from the highest point to the top end of the right vertical side is a slanted side, labeled 6 inches. Reasoning: According to the specified method, draw a line segment from the top end of the left 12-inch vertical side to the top end of the right 18-inch vertical side. Since the width of the bottom side is 8 inches, the horizontal distance between the two ends of this line segment is 8 inches; the right-side height 18 inches is 6 inches higher than the left-side height 12 inches, so the vertical difference is 6 inches. Therefore the length of the drawn line segment is sqrt(8^2+6^2)=10 inches. The three sides of the small upper triangle are 8, 6, and 10, so it is a right triangle, and its area is (1/2)*8*6=24 square inches. The lower part is a trapezoid, whose two parallel vertical sides are respectively 12 inches and 18 inches, and the perpendicular distance between them is 8 inches, so its area is ((12+18)/2)*8=120 square inches. The total area is 24+120=144 square inches.
